name: in-case-of-crisis
description: Retrieve the protocols available to your signed-in In Case of Crisis account within your organization.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve the protocols your signed-in In Case of Crisis account is authorized to access within your organization. Search or browse available protocols across emergency, safety, cyber, operational and other topics; choose between matches; and retrieve the protocol text, available escalation contacts and citations by ID. Access is enforced by In Case of Crisis. Requires an authorized In Case of Crisis account; subscriptions and payments are handled outside ChatGPT. The plugin does not create or modify protocols, send alerts or contact responders. No organizational protocols are bundled.

publication.release_notes: Updated publisher identity and public listing links; declared US-only availability and external subscription payments; broadened retrieval instructions to all protocols authorized for the signed-in person; clarified read-only boundaries; added Premium-protocol review cases and a demo recording URL.

review.commerce_description: The plugin retrieves protocols for authorized In Case of Crisis subscribers. Subscription purchases and all payments are handled entirely outside ChatGPT. The plugin does not initiate purchases or checkout, or process payments.
prompts: Show me the Building Fire/Evacuation protocol from ICC Premium Protocols.
For a preparedness exercise, what do ICC Premium Protocols say if our files are encrypted and a ransom note appears?
According to ICC Premium Protocols, who should respond when a reporter contacts us?
Show me the Earthquake protocol from ICC Premium Protocols.
Show me the available ICC Premium Protocols.

positive.description: Use the dedicated reviewer demo account. Use only results whose returned source is PREMIUM ICC PROTOCOLS. The reviewer catalogue contained the named fixture on October 30, 2026; recheck current availability. Exact-title safety lookup. Expected fixture: Building Fire/Evacuation, event_id 354517. This is a preparedness test, not an active emergency.
positive.prompt: Show me the Building Fire/Evacuation protocol from ICC Premium Protocols.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with the user wording as query. Match the exact title and PREMIUM ICC PROTOCOLS source, then retrieve its returned event_id (observed 354517), preserving the original wording in asked. Return only source-grounded guidance with its title and citation; preserve safety-critical order and qualifications and report missing information honestly. Do not retrieve a similarly named organization-specific fire plan.
